test_title: PYST 2: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 25 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Arrange the passage correctly:**
(1) He locked the door and stepped out to start his journey.
(2) He arrived at the top just in time to view the sunrise.
(3) He laced up his boots and loaded up his backpack with essentials.
(4) He traced the marked path along the forest.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage describes a sequential journey that must be logically arranged based on the timeline of events.
 
• **Sentence 3 is the first sentence** as it begins with preparations for the journey:
 
 
• "He laced up his boots and loaded up his backpack with essentials."
